results.name: physics_point_update_random_extension
results.evidence: Blends random_real_range(min,max) from a marker's range fields into a per-index extension float array (group*0x100+index), clears an active bit and calls FUN_00500090 when the sign of the result changes.
results.summary: Updates a physics/spring point's stored extension value with a randomized target scaled by a per-node weight, clearing its active flag and firing a contact callback when the extension crosses zero.

results.name: physics_point_reset_out_of_range
results.evidence: Iterates a fixed-stride array of position+radius records (DAT_00746f9c+0x170) and, for indices whose distance from param_1's position exceeds the stored radius, zeroes the point's extension float and clears its active bit, then calls FUN_00500090.
results.summary: Scans all physics/spring points against a list of reference positions+radii and resets (deactivates) any point that has moved outside its allowed range.

results.name: physics_point_spawn_contact_effect
results.evidence: Uses a Numerical-Recipes-style LCG (x = x*0x19660d + 0x3c6ef35f) to pick randomized sample points, tests them with polygon2d_point_inside_margin against nearby BSP leaf polygons in a grid search, and finally calls FUN_00549af0 with an averaged position/orientation buffer.
results.summary: Searches the local BSP region around a physics contact point for a valid surface, picks a pseudo-random sample position within it, and spawns an effect/decal there.

results.name: bsp2d_node_find_leaf
results.evidence: Walks a 20-byte-stride node array (2 floats + child index) testing sign of dot(node.ab,point)-node.c to pick pfVar1[3]/[4] as the next node, terminating when the index goes negative.
results.summary: Descends a 2D binary-partition (bsp2d) node tree to locate the leaf/edge index containing a 2D point.

results.name: bsp3d_node_find_leaf
results.evidence: Iteratively evaluates a plane array (stride 0x10: normal+d) selected by a 0xc-stride node table, masking the sign bit of the terminal index (0x7fffffff) as the leaf id; called from 36 sites, consistent with a hot low-level utility.
results.summary: Descends the 3D structure-BSP split-plane tree for a given point and returns the index of the leaf that contains it.

results.name: collision_bsp_surface_get_vertices
results.evidence: Walks a leaf-edge table (stride 0x18: surface0/surface1 + neighbour edge indices) starting from a surface's first edge, following whichever side matches param_1, and copies each edge's vertex (stride 0x10, first 3 floats) into the output buffer.
results.summary: Follows a collision-BSP surface's boundary edge loop and writes out the 3D position of each vertex around the polygon.

results.name: collision_bsp_surface_test_point_side_2d
results.evidence: Walks a surface's edge loop (same 0x18-stride table as FUN_00501400) computing a 2D cross product per edge using axis-selection tables DAT_0065c29c/DAT_0065c29e, encoding the side result into the return value.
results.summary: Tests which side of a collision-BSP surface's projected 2D boundary a query point falls on by walking the surface's edge loop.

results.name: collision_bsp_surface_closest_edge_point_2d
results.evidence: Walks the same surface edge-loop structure projecting each edge to 2D via the DAT_0065c29c/e axis tables, computing the closest point on each edge segment to param_4 and tracking convex/reflex winding state (local_2d/2e/2f) to pick the boundary closest point.
results.summary: Finds the closest point on a collision-BSP surface's 2D boundary polygon to a given 2D query point.

results.name: collision_bsp_surface_clip_line_2d
results.evidence: Walks the surface edge loop computing a cross-product-based parametric clip against each edge, maintaining running min/max hit fractions and edge indices in the output struct (classic Cyrus-Beck style line clip).
results.summary: Clips a 2D parametric line against a collision-BSP surface's boundary, returning the entry/exit fractions and the edges hit.

results.name: collision_bsp_query_sphere_init
results.evidence: Zeroes four fixed-layout result-list counters (offsets 0, 0x404, 0x808, 0xc0c on unaff_ESI, each matching a 256-entry count+array list also consumed by FUN_00503d90/FUN_00501a10/FUN_00501d20), then calls FUN_00501a10 and reports whether any entries were collected.
results.summary: Initializes a BSP sphere-collision query record and kicks off the recursive node search, returning whether any surfaces or geometry were found nearby.

results.name: collision_bsp_query_sphere_node_recursive
results.evidence: Classic BSP3D split-plane recursion (tests distance to param_1[4] radius against each plane, pushes entered plane index onto a stack at param_1[6..], recurses on both children when straddling), and at leaves records touched materials into the query record's 0xc0c-offset list.
results.summary: Recursively descends the 3D structure-BSP for a sphere-shaped query, tracking the planes crossed and recording touched material/leaf indices into the query's result lists.

results.name: collision_bsp_query_sphere_leaf_edge_recursive
results.evidence: Walks a leaf's plane-parameterized edge chain (stride 0x14) recursing via FUN_00501c90 itself when a boundary is crossed, and falls to FUN_00501d20 for negative (leaf-edge) indices.
results.summary: Recurses along a BSP leaf's boundary edges while a sphere query's margin extends past them, dispatching to geometry collection at the terminal leaf edges.

results.name: collision_bsp_query_sphere_collect_geometry
results.evidence: Deduplicates and records unique vertex indices into the query record's 0x808 list and unique leaf-edge indices into its 0x404 list, uses ray_intersects_sphere_test as a fallback check, and finally appends the surface index itself to the record's primary (offset 0) list.
results.summary: For a surface potentially touched by a moving sphere, records the nearby unique vertices, leaf-edges and the surface itself into the collision query's result lists.

results.name: physics_shape_pill_query_init
results.evidence: Clamps the incoming fraction (param_6) to [0,1], zeroes an 0x28-ish query record's hit fields (material/leaf indices set to -1, fraction to the clamped value), and forwards to FUN_00502140.
results.summary: Initializes a segment/pill collision query record with a clamped parametric fraction before running the recursive BSP node test.

results.name: physics_shape_pill_node_test_recursive
results.evidence: Classic min/max-fraction BSP3D plane-clip recursion (recurses via FUN_00502140 itself on the near side, updates param_1[6] fraction on the far side), and at leaves calls FUN_00502460 then checks two-sided/invisible material bits (0x2/0x8) before filling the hit-result struct.
results.summary: Recursively clips a line segment against the 3D structure-BSP, finding the nearest surface the segment crosses and filling in its material/vertex data.

results.name: collision_bsp_surface_test_point_leaf
results.evidence: Walks a leaf's surface-material entries, uses ABS-magnitude comparisons on the surface plane normal (same pattern as FUN_00503290) to pick the dominant axis, calls FUN_00501340 to project the point, and optionally FUN_00502600 for a two-sided containment check.
results.summary: Within a BSP leaf, finds the surface (if any) whose projected polygon contains a given point, accounting for two-sided material handling.

results.name: collision_bsp_surface_test_point_2d
results.evidence: Standalone version of the edge-loop 2D side test seen in FUN_005014a0 (same DAT_0065c29c/e axis tables and 0x18-stride edge structure), returning a packed side/inside flag.
results.summary: Tests whether a 2D point lies inside a collision-BSP surface's projected boundary polygon.

results.name: physics_shape_segment_query_init
results.evidence: Clamps the incoming distance parameter to non-negative, zeroes a query record's hit fields, and forwards to FUN_005027a0 (mirrors the structure of FUN_00502060/FUN_00502140 pairing).
results.summary: Initializes a swept-sphere/segment collision query record before invoking the recursive BSP node search.

results.name: collision_bsp_query_pill_node_recursive
results.evidence: Recursive BSP3D descent tracking an accumulated plane stack (param_1[5..]), and at leaves computes a barycentric-projected contact point from two plane normals and calls FUN_00502d60, closely mirroring FUN_00501a10's structure but producing a slide contact instead of a material list.
results.summary: Recursively tests a swept sphere/pill against the 3D structure-BSP, computing the deepest contact fraction and a projected contact point for collision response.

results.name: collision_bsp_query_pill_leaf_recursive
results.evidence: Evaluates a leaf-local plane equation against the query's projected 2D position (param_1[0x87]/[0x88]) with a small epsilon (0.00012207031), recursing into FUN_00502d60 itself or FUN_00502e70 depending on which side is crossed.
results.summary: Descends a BSP leaf's local plane structure for a swept-sphere query, recursing toward the edges that the query's margin overlaps.

results.name: collision_bsp_query_pill_leaf_test_surface
results.evidence: Walks a leaf's edge loop, calls FUN_00503050 (closest-approach solver) per edge, and on improvement updates the query's closest fraction, contact position (normalized) and material/leaf-edge fields.
results.summary: Tests a swept sphere against each edge of a BSP leaf's boundary, keeping the closest valid contact found.

results.name: physics_shape_pill_sweep_test_point
results.evidence: Solves the standard moving-sphere-vs-point quadratic (discriminant = b^2-4ac via fVar3/fVar1/fVar8/fVar6 combination, SQRT of discriminant) to find the sweep fraction and closest-point ratio, falling back to FUN_00503290 for the segment-endpoint cases.
results.summary: Computes the fraction along a swept segment at which a moving sphere (of given radius) first touches a fixed point/edge.

results.name: physics_shape_sphere_sweep_test_ray
results.evidence: Second quadratic solve (distance-to-point vs radius, then along-ray discriminant) used as a fallback from FUN_00503050 and FUN_00502460 when the primary closest-approach case doesn't resolve.
results.summary: Fallback ray-vs-sphere intersection helper returning the entry fraction when a point already lies outside a given radius.

results.name: physics_shape_vertex_to_sphere
results.evidence: Appends a fixed 0x1c-stride record (matching the sphere-array layout consumed by FUN_00504260/FUN_00504430) to a list capped at 0x100 entries, and conditionally a second, margin-offset entry when param_1 (thickness) is positive.
results.summary: Converts a BSP vertex (optionally offset by a collision margin) into one or two sphere collision-proxy entries appended to a local physics shape list.

results.name: physics_shape_edge_to_pill_and_quad
results.evidence: Appends two 0x28-stride records (matching the pill/capsule list also written by FUN_005038a0/read by FUN_00504260) offset by the margin along a perpendicular basis, then builds a 4-vertex quad and appends a 0x68-stride shape-list record (same layout as FUN_005038a0's output).
results.summary: Converts a BSP edge (with a collision margin) into rounded pill collision proxies at its ends plus a flat quad shape proxy along its length.

results.name: physics_shape_surface_to_polygon
results.evidence: Picks the dominant axis from the surface plane normal (ABS comparisons, same idiom as FUN_00502460/FUN_00503290), projects each input vertex to 2D via the DAT_0065c29e/c axis tables, and appends a 0x68-stride record to the shape list (same layout consumed by FUN_00504120/FUN_00504260).
results.summary: Converts a collision-BSP surface's polygon (optionally offset along its normal) into a physics-model polygon/shape collision-proxy entry.

results.name: physics_shape_add_vertex_proxy
results.evidence: Optionally transforms param_1 via matrix4x3_transform_point, then forwards to FUN_00503360 (vertex-to-sphere proxy builder).
results.summary: Wrapper that transforms a BSP vertex into world/local space (if a matrix is given) and appends it as a sphere collision proxy.

results.name: physics_shape_add_edge_proxy
results.evidence: Reads a leaf-edge's two adjacent surfaces, uses FUN_0044d8e0 (a dot/angle threshold of +/-0.0001) to skip near-coplanar or matching-side edges, transforms endpoints, and forwards to FUN_00503490 (edge-to-pill/quad proxy builder).
results.summary: Wrapper that filters out redundant/coplanar BSP edges and appends the remaining ones as pill/quad collision proxies.

results.name: physics_shape_add_surface_proxy
results.evidence: Fetches a surface's vertex loop via FUN_00501400, transforms each vertex with matrix4x3_transform_point, applies an angular+linear velocity correction (13-float unaff_ESI matrix) via FUN_0044dad0, then forwards to FUN_005038a0 (surface-to-polygon proxy builder).
results.summary: Wrapper that transforms a BSP surface's polygon (accounting for a moving reference frame) and appends it as a shape collision proxy.

results.name: physics_shape_build_proxies_from_query
results.evidence: Iterates the three geometry-list fields of a collision query record (unaff_EDI[0x202], [0x101] and [0]) calling FUN_00503a60/FUN_00503ae0/FUN_00503c50 respectively for each entry.
results.summary: Builds a local sphere/pill/shape physics model from a BSP collision query's collected vertices, edges and surfaces.

results.name: physics_shape_sphere_test_point
results.evidence: Computes squared distance from a point to a center (in_ECX+0xc/0x10/0x14) and compares to a stored radius (in_ECX+0x18), producing a normal and penetration depth on overlap - matches the sphere entry layout used by FUN_00503360/FUN_00504260.
results.summary: Tests a point against a sphere-shaped collision proxy, returning the penetration depth and separating normal when they overlap.

results.name: physics_shape_pill_test_point
results.evidence: Projects a point onto a capsule axis (in_ECX+0x18..0x24), clamping to the segment and normalizing via vector3d_normalize_with_length - matches the pill entry layout used by FUN_00503490/FUN_00504260.
results.summary: Tests a point against a pill/capsule-shaped collision proxy, returning the penetration depth and separating normal when they overlap.

results.name: physics_shape_polygon_test_point
results.evidence: Tests a point's projected distance against a plane (in_ECX+0xc..0x18) and, within range, walks a 2D vertex loop (in_ECX+0x28, stride 8) with cross-product half-plane tests, matching the polygon/shape entry layout used by FUN_005038a0/FUN_00504260.
results.summary: Tests a point against a flat polygon (shape) collision proxy, returning the penetration depth when the point lies within the polygon's projected area.

results.name: physics_shape_test_point
results.evidence: Iterates three fixed-stride arrays at offsets 8 (0x1c stride, spheres), 0x1c08 (0x28 stride, pills) and 0x4408 (0x68 stride, shapes) via a switch on shape type (0/1/2), calling FUN_00503ec0/FUN_00503f90/FUN_00504120 respectively and tracking the deepest overlap.
results.summary: Tests a point against every sphere, pill and polygon shape in a local physics model, returning the deepest overlapping contact.

results.name: physics_shape_sphere_test_ray
results.evidence: Ray-vs-sphere quadratic (unaff_ESI center/radius vs in_EAX origin, in_ECX direction) analogous to FUN_00503ec0 but parameterized along a direction, used by the ray dispatcher FUN_00504bb0.
results.summary: Tests a directed ray/segment against a sphere collision proxy, returning the hit fraction and surface normal.

results.name: physics_shape_pill_test_ray
results.evidence: Solves the cylinder/capsule-vs-ray quadratic against the pill axis (unaff_EDI+0x18..0x24), clamping the along-axis parameter, then finishes with point3d_add_scaled/vector3d_normalize_with_length - the ray counterpart of FUN_00503f90.
results.summary: Tests a directed ray/segment against a pill/capsule collision proxy, returning the hit fraction and surface normal.

results.name: physics_shape_polygon_test_ray
results.evidence: Clips a segment's plane-crossing interval (Liang-Barsky style, local_2c/local_28 min/max) then walks the polygon's 2D edge loop (in_ECX+0x28, stride 8) refining the interval per edge - the ray counterpart of FUN_00504120.
results.summary: Tests a directed ray/segment against a flat polygon (shape) collision proxy, returning the entry fraction where it crosses the polygon.

results.name: physics_shape_test_ray
results.evidence: Same three-array (spheres/pills/shapes) iteration and shape-type switch as FUN_00504260, but dispatching to the ray-test variants FUN_00504430/FUN_005045c0/FUN_005048d0 and requiring the hit be facing against the direction (dot < -0.0001).
results.summary: Tests a directed ray/segment against every sphere, pill and polygon shape in a local physics model, returning the closest facing hit.

results.name: object_get_physics_shapes
results.evidence: Resolves an object index through the object table (DAT_008603b0+0x34) and its tag definition (DAT_0087bc14, 0x20-stride array), checks a 'physics parent' field at +0x7c, and returns the object index, parent definition pointer, a shapes pointer (puVar1+0x60) and a materials-array offset (+0x1f2).
results.summary: Looks up an object's collision-model shape and material data via its tag definition, failing if it has no attached physics.

results.name: object_nodes_test_bsp_leaf
results.evidence: Iterates an object's collision-node array (count/stride 0x40 from unaff_EBX+4), inverse-transforms each into local BSP space via matrix4x3_inverse_transform_point, and calls FUN_005013a0 (bsp3d_node_find_leaf), failing if any node resolves to no leaf.
results.summary: Checks whether all of an object's collision nodes resolve to a valid BSP leaf, i.e. are not embedded outside the world's collision geometry.

results.name: object_nodes_test_bsp_pill
results.evidence: Same node-array iteration as FUN_00504e90 but calls matrix4x3_inverse/transform_point/transform_vector followed by FUN_00502060 (pill/segment query init) per node, recording a hit node/leaf/index on success.
results.summary: Tests each of an object's collision nodes as a capsule/pill query against the local BSP, recording the first node that reports a valid contact.

results.name: object_nodes_test_bsp_shape
results.evidence: Structurally identical to FUN_00504f60 but calls FUN_00502730 (segment/shape query init) scaled by param_4 instead of FUN_00502060.
results.summary: Tests each of an object's collision nodes as a scaled segment query against the local BSP, recording the first node that reports a valid contact.

results.name: object_nodes_apply_bsp_contact
results.evidence: Same per-node iteration pattern as FUN_00504f60/FUN_005050b0, but on a valid inverse-transformed node calls FUN_00501980 (sphere query) and, on success, FUN_00503d90 to build local physics-model proxies for that node's contact.
results.summary: Iterates an object's collision nodes, running a sphere collision query at each and building local physics-model contact proxies for any node that touches geometry.

results.name: object_marker_get_node_index
results.evidence: Trivial table lookup: given a short index (in_AX) into a 0x48-stride table (in_ECX+0x238), returns the node-index field at +0x24, or -1 if the index was -1.
results.summary: Returns the model node index associated with a given marker index, or -1 if the marker index is invalid.

results.name: object_test_collision_recursive
results.evidence: Recursively walks an object linked-list (+0x114 'next', +0x118 'child' fields), testing bounding-sphere overlap (position at +0xa0.., radius at +0xac) against param_3, then dispatching by material type (+0xb4) to either node-vs-bsp tests (FUN_00504e10/FUN_00504e90) or object-relative tests (FUN_005074b0/FUN_00507590).
results.summary: Recursively searches a chain of nearby objects for one whose collision geometry overlaps a given position, excluding a specified object.

results.name: object_test_collision_group
results.evidence: For contact-type flags in bits 5-7, resolves an object's containing structure/cluster via FUN_00501400... (actually FUN_004f5f00) and walks a sibling object chain calling FUN_00505350 on each.
results.summary: Walks the group of objects associated with a cluster/parent to test whether any of them collides with a given point.

results.name: physics_point_test_and_clear
results.evidence: Looks up the current BSP3D leaf via FUN_005013a0 and, if valid, updates a physics-point active flag/list through FUN_00501980, returning whether the query succeeded.
results.summary: Thin wrapper that re-evaluates a physics point's containing BSP leaf and refreshes its active/contact state.

results.name: object_test_collision_ray_recursive
results.evidence: Same object linked-list recursion as FUN_00505350 (+0x114/+0x118 fields), but uses ray_intersects_sphere_test and dispatches to the ray-based node/shape tests (FUN_00504f60, FUN_005074b0/FUN_00507610), recording the closest hit into param_7.
results.summary: Recursively casts a ray/segment against a chain of nearby objects, keeping track of the closest valid collision result.

results.name: physics_move_test_collision
results.evidence: Tests a movement segment against structure door/portal planes (psVar14 table) and, via the object linked-list recursion FUN_005055b0, against nearby dynamic objects; on a hit it iteratively re-queries the destination's BSP leaf (FUN_005013a0/FUN_0053e780) backing off by a small epsilon until clear.
results.summary: Casts a movement segment through the world, testing it against structure doors and nearby objects, and nudges the endpoint out of any surfaces it would otherwise penetrate.

results.name: physics_move_test_collision_shapes
results.evidence: Similar structure to FUN_00505880 but drives its BSP query through FUN_00502730 (shape/segment query init) and re-resolves the leaf via FUN_005013a0 after clamping the movement fraction.
results.summary: Variant movement-segment collision test that queries the local physics-model shapes rather than raw BSP surfaces directly.

results.name: object_scan_nearby_for_collision_effect
results.evidence: Recursively walks the object cluster linked-list testing bounding-sphere overlap, then switches on material type (+0xb4): case 0 spawns a decal/effect via FUN_0055a2e0 + FUN_00503360, other cases run node-vs-bsp pill/segment tests via FUN_00504e10+FUN_00505200 or FUN_005074b0+FUN_00507790.
results.summary: Searches nearby objects along a movement path for collisions, spawning contact effects for some material types and running detailed node collision tests for others.

results.name: physics_move_and_notify_contacts
results.evidence: Runs a sphere query (FUN_00501980) and builds local physics-model proxies (FUN_00503d90), then, gated by a flag bit, walks a hash-linked object set (DAT_008603d0/d4) invoking FUN_005061c0 once per unique object per collision epoch (DAT_006e3f04 generation counter), returning whether any of param_7's three output flags were set.
results.summary: Performs a movement collision test against both static BSP geometry and nearby dynamic objects, deduplicating repeated object visits, and reports which kinds of contact occurred.

results.name: point3d_project_onto_line
results.evidence: Self-contained vector projection: t = dot(point-origin, dir)/dot(dir,dir); result = origin + t*dir - the standard closed-form point-onto-line projection with no register/global dependencies beyond its own inputs.
results.summary: Projects a 3D point onto an infinite line defined by an origin and direction vector.

results.name: physics_slide_along_constraint_planes
results.evidence: Iteratively calls FUN_00504bb0 (shape ray test) along a shrinking velocity, and on each hit resolves the remaining motion against up to three accumulated constraint planes using plane3d_intersect_pair_to_line / plane3d_intersect_three and point3d_project_onto_line (FUN_005066e0), finishing with an indirect jump table dispatch by constraint count.
results.summary: Iteratively slides a moving point along the planes, edges or vertices it collides with, producing a final constrained position/velocity.

results.name: physics_move_sweep_capsule
results.evidence: Builds a capsule center from a half-step of the velocity plus a radius, calls FUN_00506440 (move + notify contacts) and, on collision, resolves the remainder via FUN_005067b0 (slide along planes); otherwise returns the unobstructed straight-line move.
results.summary: Sweeps a capsule-approximated movement step through the world, sliding along any surfaces it touches.

results.name: physics_point_settle_to_rest
results.evidence: Repeatedly shrinks a remaining-distance value by a fixed 0.03125 step while FUN_00505490 (collision test) keeps succeeding, moving a point toward a base position along a given direction, and snaps to the base position once the remaining distance is exhausted or the test fails.
results.summary: Walks a physics point step-by-step toward a target position while collision-testing each step, stopping as soon as it becomes blocked.

results.name: physics_point_find_valid_position
results.evidence: Builds a capsule sweep via FUN_00506440/FUN_00504260 to check for immediate overlap, then, if blocked, samples 17 fixed candidate directions from lookup tables (DAT_0069c460/64/68) around the original point, testing each with FUN_00504260/FUN_00504bb0 and accepting the first sufficiently clear direction (dot > 0.76604444, i.e. within ~40 degrees), finally settling via FUN_005070d0.
results.summary: Searches for a nearby non-colliding position for a physics point by sampling a ring of candidate offsets when the direct position is blocked, then settles the point there.

results.name: math_smoothstep_ratio_clamped
results.evidence: Self-contained: returns 0.0, 1.0, or (b-a)/(b-c) style clamped linear ratio of param_1 relative to param_2/param_3, using x87 float10 return with no external/global state.
results.summary: Computes a clamped linear interpolation fraction of a value between two reference values, returning 0 or 1 at the extremes.

results.name: object_get_parent_relative_velocity
results.evidence: Resolves an object's 'physics parent' via a tag-definition field at +0x8c, calls object_get_position/object_get_orientation on both, computes an angular-velocity cross product via vector3d_cross_product, and transforms the result into local space with matrix4x3_transform_point, negating the components.
results.summary: Computes an object's velocity relative to its physics-parent object, used when a physics point is attached to a moving parent.

results.name: physics_shape_forward_call_helper
results.evidence: Trivial wrapper with no globals or additional logic: calls FUN_0044d860(param_2) purely for its side effect and returns param_2 unchanged; the callee's purpose could not be determined from this file.
results.summary: Thin pass-through helper that invokes an unnamed utility function and returns its second argument unchanged.
